reason: This plugin is primarily a mobile UI optimization extension for the DeepSeek Harness web shell, focused on responsive layout and interaction improvements (drawer sidebar, full-screen settings sheet, bottom-sheet details, touch target adjustments) with a small client-side injection footprint and no file/network/service capabilities in the provided evidence.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，通过小屏断点下的样式与覆盖层组件适配，将侧边栏、设置页和详情区域的布局改为更适合移动端和触控操作的展示。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin that optimizes mobile and small-tablet screens by using responsive CSS and lightweight overlay components to improve sidebar, settings, and details panel interactions.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS for small-screen UI layout adjustments
Registers and renders overlay UI components in host-defined slots
Reads layout state and drives responsive behavior via the runtime context

reasons.code: The package declares a web client plugin entry (`dsh.client`) and peer dependencies for DSH client UI runtime modules, confirming client-side extension execution rather than backend logic.
The plugin is described as injecting one `<style>` block and registering a React overlay component into shell slots, indicating direct DOM/UI-layer modification in the browser.
Behavior is explicitly scoped to `@media (max-width: 820px)` and targets UI elements such as sidebar, settings panel, and details panel, limiting impact to mobile/small-tablet layouts.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS for small-screen UI layout adjustments
